newsitem.title: MEXICO: Situr denies Hyatt and Posadas contact.
newsitem.headline: Situr denies Hyatt and Posadas contact.

text.p: Situr's director-general denied suggestions on Friday that the company had approached its counterparts Hyatt and Posadas with a view to selling hotels to them.

"We have no knowledge of that and have not floated the idea, because any sale of assets not forming part of our business plan would have to be undertaken in a very ordered manner," said Situr director Luis Rebollar Corona.
"There are no talks between the two (Posadas and Hyatt)...we are having no talks with them," Rebollar said in a telephone interview with Reuters.
Situr stock rose Friday on market rumors that the group was planning a sale of hotels.
Rebollar said the company's debt restructuring plan would not be presented until mid-October.
"I won't have the restructuring plan ready until mid-October, no one knows about my businesss plan...I'm not going to rush something out I don't believe in," he added.
